PREFACE
The title An Illustrated Dictionary of Important Terms and Effects in Optoelectronics and Photonics reflects
exactly the contents of this dictionary.

text: It is not meant to be an encyclopedia in this field but rather a self- contained semiquantitative description of terms and effects that frequently turn up in optoelectronics and photonics courses at the undergraduate level.

text: In our own view there is very little difference between optoelectronics and photonics, except that in the latter there may not be any electronics involved.

text: Today, photonics is a more fashionable term than the old optoelectronics term which usually conjectures images of LEDs, solar cells, optoisolators etc, whereas photonics is closely associated with optical communications and optical signal processing.

text: Dipolar (orientational) polarization arises when randomly oriented polar molecules in a dielectric are rotated and aligned by the application of a field so as to give rise to a net average dipole moment per molecule.
text_raw:
Dipolar (orientational) polarization arises when randomly oriented polar molecules in a dielectric
are rotated and aligned by the application of a field so as to give rise to a net average dipole moment
per molecule.

In the absence of the field the dipoles (polar molecules) are randomly oriented and
there is no average dipole moment per molecule.

some partially and some fully, to align with the field and hence give rise to a net dipole moment per

energy in the dipole alignment to heat through lattice vibrations or molecular collisions.

text: Drawing in fiber manufacture is a process in which a glass preform rod is slowly fed into a hot furnace that has a hot zone around 1900-2000 Â°C where the glass flows like a viscous melt (resembling honey).

Drawing in fiber manufacture is a process in which a glass preform rod is slowly fed into a hot
furnace that has a hot zone around 1900-2000 Â°C where the glass flows like a viscous melt
(resembling honey).

text: As the rod reaches the hot zone and its end begins to flow, its tip is pulled, with just the right tension, to come out as a fiber and is spooled on a rotating take-up drum.

text: An optical thickness monitor gauge provides information on the changes of the fiber diameter which is used (in an automatic feedback control system) to adjust the speed of the fiber winding mechanism and the speed of the preform feeder to maintain a constant fiber diameter, typically better than 0.1%.

thickness monitor gauge provides information on the changes of the fiber diameter which is used (in

speed of the preform feeder to maintain a constant fiber diameter, typically better than 0.1%.

Safa Kasap is currently a Professor of Electronic Materials and Devices in the
Electrical Engineering Department at the University of Saskatchewan, Canada.

text: He obtained his PhD (1983) degree from Imperial College of Science, Technology and Medicine, University of London, specializing in amorphous semiconductors and optoelectronics.
text_raw:
He obtained his PhD (1983) degree from Imperial College of Science,
Technology and Medicine, University of London, specializing in amorphous
semiconductors and optoelectronics.

text: In 1996 he was awarded the DSc (Engineering) degree from London University for his research contributions to materials science in electrical engineering.
text_raw:
In 1996 he was awarded the DSc
(Engineering) degree from London University for his research contributions to
materials science in electrical engineering.

text: He is a Fellow of the Institution of Electrical Engineers, the Institute of Physics and the Institute of Materials.
text_raw:
He is a Fellow of the Institution of
Electrical Engineers, the Institute of Physics and the Institute of Materials.

text: His research interests are in amorphous semiconductors, noise in electronic devices, photoconductors, photodetectors, X-ray image detectors, laser induced transient photoconductivity and related topics, with more than one hundred refereed journal publications in these areas.
